fn001.title: Spanish Rice with Eggs
fn001.instructions:
Toast rice in a pan.
Add onion and pepper; cook 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, paprika and broth.
Simmer 20 minutes.
Top with fried eggs.
Serve.
Garnish.

fn002.title: Applesauce Spice Cake
fn002.instructions:
Preheat oven.
Mix everything.
Bake 35 minutes.

fn003.title: Banana Pancakes
fn003.instructions:
Whisk egg, milk and banana.
Stir in flour and sugar.
Cook on a griddle.

fn004.title: Saffron Paella
fn004.instructions:
Cook onion.
Add rice, saffron and stock.
Add shrimp and finish.
